primitives.name: Windy Day Kick Strategy
primitives.verbatim_quote: On a very windy day it is often desirable to try an extremely high kick, even though a short one, in order to try the nerve of the opposing back field and to develop a muff.
primitives.assumptions: Wind vector affects trajectory variance; opponent backfield is vulnerable to disruption.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High wind velocity (>15 mph) with low ball speed.

layer2.mapping: GSE-derived kernel for wind-adjusted kick trajectory prediction and opponent reaction modeling.
layer2.telemetry: Ball trajectory deviation and opponent backfield movement patterns.

primitives.name: Quick Kick Advantage
primitives.verbatim_quote: The quick kick is strong when there is a kicker capable of getting his distance in that manner.
primitives.assumptions: Kicker skill is deterministic; opponent defense is reactive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When opponent defense is slow to react or mispositioned.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic model of kick execution success rate versus opponent defensive lag.
layer2.telemetry: Kick execution time and defensive reaction delay.
